objective: Compare group-conditioned against global split-calibrated HAC trend intervals, grouping solely by observed detrended residual AR1 coefficient, not hidden synthetic scenario labels.
features: Using complete 240-sample continuation, subtract least-squares linear trend from raw measurements then compute residual AR1 as sum(r[t]*r[t-1])/sum(r[t-1]^2). Group by fixed cutoffs .50/.80.
decision: Full240 ten-sample medians, centered OLS slope, HAC lag 3 SE. Interval estimate ± group_multiplier*SE. Confirm if interval excludes zero, reject if interval entirely in (-.0032,.0032), otherwise unresolved. Same rule for global benchmark.
fallback: Group with <30 calibration points must use global multiplier; empty group explicitly recorded.

report: coverage by scenario and observable group

limitations: Groups selected by full observations, not live predecision; this is an interval audit, not online stopping policy.
No observations in low bin during calibration; global fallback is not evidence of conditional coverage there.
Calibrated on known synthetic generator family; only seeds change.
Split conformal marginal coverage needs exchangeability, cannot guarantee each group's coverage under temporal changes.
